name: flex_loan_adjustments
_comment: Six overlays, at five points, in a declared order. `position` is the composition order and it CHANGES THE PRICE: a score shift then a PD multiplier is not the same as a PD multiplier then a score shift, because calibration sits between them. The whole set is switchable off with `enabled: false`, through the same implementation and the same kernel, because the set is a runtime array and not a compile-time constant.

overlays.description: New-to-bank early-life deterioration on the call centre channel.
overlays.rationale: Vintage analysis to 2026-06 shows 90-day arrears on scorecard 1012 channel 4 running 1.9x the portfolio for the 2025-Q4 and 2026-Q1 cohorts. A rebuild is scheduled for 2027-Q1; this holds the line until then.

overlays.description: Flatten the score-to-odds curve at the tails for the existing-client scorecard.
overlays.rationale: Realised odds at scores above 720 and below 470 diverge from the fitted 20-point relationship by more than the validation tolerance. Moving to 22 restores tail calibration without a refit.
Observed defaults 30% above prediction on channel 4 for two consecutive quarters. Applied while the model is rebuilt. Impact estimate at CC-2026-31: approval rate -2.4pp, volume -1 320/month.

overlays.description: Move the grade 6/7 boundary from 4.60% to 4.20% PD.
overlays.rationale: Tightens the top of the acceptable range ahead of the 2026-Q4 appetite review.

overlays.description: Amount cap x 0.80 on the call centre channel for the quarter.
overlays.rationale: Loss-given-default on channel 4 originations above R100 000 is 14pp worse than the book. Reduces exposure while the channel's verification process is remediated.

overlays.description: 50 basis points on grades 9 to 12 across all terms.
overlays.rationale: Reissuing a 63 360-cell card takes three weeks; the repricing decision was made on 2026-07-24 and the margin position does not survive three weeks. To be folded into the 2026-11-A card and this overlay retired on the same date.
overlays._note: Scope covers all 96 amount bands, so it contributes no new breakpoints to the search partition. A scope of bands 40-70 WOULD contribute two, and the search would pick them up automatically via `contributes_breakpoints`.
